review.note: Approved one by one in define-gate slot G3-01 of the resolution-recipe-eval package (REQ-224 exception (b)); the docs PR carrying the answered slot merged 2026-10-10.

question: My opponent controls Blood Moon. I play Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth after it. Can Urborg and my other nonbasic lands tap for black mana?

expected.shortAnswer: No: Urborg's effect depends on Blood Moon's, so Blood Moon applies first and Urborg makes nothing a Swamp.
expected.answer: No. Blood Moon and Urborg are both type-changing effects, applied in layer 4 (613.1d). Urborg's effect depends on Blood Moon's, because applying Blood Moon removes Urborg's ability (613.8a), so Blood Moon applies first even though Urborg entered later (613.8b). Blood Moon makes Urborg a Mountain, and a land whose subtype is set to a basic land type loses the abilities from its rules text (305.7), so Urborg makes no land a Swamp. Urborg and your other nonbasic lands are Mountains: they tap for red, not black. Basic Swamps you control still tap for black.

whyHard: Timestamp order says Urborg applies last, but Urborg's effect depends on Blood Moon's, so dependency reverses the order inside layer 4 and Urborg never makes a Swamp.
